hints.title: Integer Scale Travel Distance
hints.text: Multiply all times by speed so that travel times correspond to exact integer distance totals, avoiding floating point imprecision.

hints.title: Skip Count State Transitions
hints.text: Let dp[j] be the minimum scaled distance elapsed after processing roads using exactly j rest skips.

hints.title: Ceiling Rest Boundary
hints.text: Without skip, round the distance elapsed up to the nearest multiple of speed; with skip, proceed without rest.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: n is length of dist array
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all 2^n skip combinations takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dynamic programming over skip count j computes scaled arrival distances in O(n^2) time and O(n) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate uses exact integer distance scaling ((d + speed - 1) / speed) * speed to prevent precision errors.
